The museum's imposing structure, with its high ceilings and interconnected galleries, invites visitors into a realm where time seems to stand still, offering a serene contrast to the vibrant cityscape outside. Upon entering, one is immediately enveloped by a warm, inviting atmosphere, thanks to the soft yellow lighting that gently illuminates the glass display cases housing ancient artifacts.
